myproxy_server_port.description: TCP port the MyProxy server listens on for incoming credential requests.

myproxy_data_port.description: Port used for gridFTP data connections; set to 0 to disable data transfer.

myproxy_server_host.description: Host IP address or hostname the server binds to (e.g., 'myproxy.example.com' or '127.0.0.1').

myproxy_server_cred_dir.description: Directory where user credentials are persistently stored.

myproxy_max_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime (in hours) allowed for stored credentials (e.g., 168 = 1 week).

myproxy_min_lifetime.description: Minimum lifetime (in hours) required for newly stored credentials.

myproxy_default_lifetime.description: Default lifetime (in hours) applied when no explicit lifetime is requested.

myproxy_delegate.description: If enabled, allows users to delegate credentials (i.e., issue new proxies from stored credentials).

myproxy_revoke.description: If enabled, allows users to revoke stored credentials before expiration.

myproxy_ssl.description: If enabled, enforces TLS/SSL encryption for all MyProxy connections.

myproxy_server_cert.description: Path to the server's X.509 certificate file.

myproxy_server_key.description: Path to the server's private key file (must be protected, mode 0400).

myproxy_ca_certs.description: Path to the directory containing trusted CA certificates.

myproxy_allowed_users.description: List of allowed user DNs or usernames; if empty, all authenticated users are permitted.

myproxy_allowed_groups.description: List of allowed VOMS or POSIX groups; if empty, all groups are permitted.

myproxy_syslog.description: If enabled, log events to the system syslog daemon.

myproxy_log_file.description: Path to a dedicated log file (if empty, logging goes only to syslog).

myproxy_num_threads.description: Number of worker threads to handle concurrent connections.

myproxy_voms.description: If enabled, integrate with VOMS for attribute-based authorization.

myproxy_voms_config.description: Path to the VOMS configuration file (required if VOMS is enabled).

hostname.description: Fully qualified hostname of the VOMS server (e.g., 'voms.example.org').

port.description: TCP port of the VOMS server (typically 15000 or 8443).

ca_path.description: Path to the VOMS CA certificate file or directory (e.g., '/etc/grid-security/vomsdir').

myproxy_voms_servers.description: List of trusted VOMS servers used for attribute validation.

myproxy_rotate.description: If enabled, automatically refreshes credentials before expiry (requires proxy renewal infrastructure).

myproxy_rotate_interval.description: Interval (in hours) between checks for credentials due for rotation.

myproxy_batch.description: If enabled, allows non-interactive (batch) credential requests (use with caution).

myproxy_no_passphrase.description: If enabled, allows storing credentials without passphrase protection (not recommended).

myproxy_max_credentials.description: Maximum number of credentials stored per user account.

myproxy_rfc_proxy.description: If enabled, generate RFC-compliant proxy certificates (recommended for interoperability).
